question: Which client has the highest revenue?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, ROUND(SUM(i.total_net_amount), 2) AS revenue 
FROM invoice i 
JOIN customers c ON i.client_name_id = c.id 
WHERE i.created_at BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2026-09-30 23:59:59' 
GROUP BY c.customer_name 
ORDER BY revenue DESC 
LIMIT 1
answer_excerpt:
